personality_profile: Reserved and soft-spoken. Keeps strong feelings inside, prefers to listen, and shows emotion subtly — a slight smile, a quiet pause, downcast eyes. Rarely raises her voice even when upset.
character_base_profile: Aoi is a first-year high-school girl. Today is the first day of the new school term, and she is an ordinary student hoping to start the year off on the right foot.
title: Corner, Impact, and Attendance

dialogue.text: The first morning of the new school term -- and Aoi is already running late.
No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: Her loafer slips on the polished hallway floor as she hugs a stack of freshly printed class schedules to her chest.
She had stopped at the staff room to return them after a teacher mistook her for a committee helper.
A solid shoulder crashes into hers.
The schedules burst from her arms like scattered cards.
A tall boy in a different blazer trim steadies himself with a click of his tongue.
His voice is blunt, but he crouches first, gathering papers before they slide under the lockers.
If you kneel there, people will step on you.
dialogue.speaker: Unknown Boy

dialogue.text: Aoi drops to her knees anyway, cheeks burning.
She reaches for the last sheet at the same time he does.
Their fingers touch. She pulls back at once.
At the top page, in bold marker, someone has written: CLASS 1-A.
Then you're running the wrong way.
dialogue.speaker: Unknown Boy

dialogue.text: The first-years were moved to the east wing this morning.
dialogue.speaker: Unknown Boy

dialogue.text: Her stomach drops. That explains the empty hall. The wrong staircase. The wasted minutes.
He stands, already turning away, then glances back when she doesn't move.
He says it like an inconvenience, but he slows his stride for her.
For a moment, neither speaks. Their footsteps fill the corridor.
He blinks, as if the words caught him off guard.
They reach the east wing just as the warning chime rings.
Aoi hands them over with both hands, breathless but in time.
Good save. And you must be our transfer student. Perfect timing.
dialogue.speaker: Teacher

dialogue.text: The boy exhales through his nose, like he'd hoped to avoid an audience.
So we're in the same class.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: A small, helpless laugh slips out of her before she can hide it.
Then I really did crash into my morning.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: For the first time, the corner of his mouth lifts.
